lines: IMAGE TYPE: Original 19th-century sepia photograph / cabinet card with perimeter water damage and patina
SUBJECT: Alfred Bookram (b. 1833 Granville County, NC - d. aft. 1880), son of Elias Bookram and Chashe Scott
